Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Desktop Controls Tour: Insert an interactive Desktop Controls screen immediately after home intro to show users how to interact with, hide, or trigger animations for their pet on desktop. (why: 3 support emails reported post-onboarding confusion on how to control or hide pets, contributing to the finish drop-off (64.8% conversion).)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Sign-In Shift: Move the sign-in step to occur immediately after pet adoption certificate creation right before waiting for desktop launch. (why: 8 support emails cited missing or reset pets after signing in again; moving sign-in right after certificate generation ensures account sync happens when pet data is fresh.)
2: [home, new_flow] Desktop Render Verification Flow: Add an interactive loading and GPU overlay permissions verification sub-flow to the waiting screen. (why: 3 support emails reported that pets failed to display on desktop or the app wouldn't open, while home waiting has high mean duration (2336s).)
3: [home, notification] Desktop Ready Tray Sound Alert: Enable system audio chime and notify_when_ready toggle during the pet generation waiting screen. (why: The waiting screen has a high median wait time of 201s (mean 2336s), causing users to switch windows and miss when onboarding completes.)
4: [adoption, hint] Adoption Certificate Account Preservation Hint: Show a clear reassurance hint on the adoption certificate screen explaining that the pet ID is saved to their cloud profile. (why: 8 support emails complained about lost pets or accounts resetting after sign-in.)
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Feature Tip Carousel: Add an auto-rotating tip carousel on the waiting screen explaining desktop pet controls and shortcuts while loading. (why: High median wait time (201s) on waiting screen and post-onboarding support tickets asking how to hide or talk to pets.)
6: [choose_path, copy] Story Screen Clarity Refresh: Update headline and body on the story screen to set clear expectations on how quick and easy desktop pet setup is. (why: Mean time spent on choose_path is 514s, indicating initial user hesitation or lack of context.)
